activation.note: The source states an unconditional feature-sizing and limit invariant, so creation, any edit, and validation of existing or incomplete feature plans are appropriate triggers. Unrelated implementation and unaffected non-feature artifacts are excluded. Field-diff and computed-finding detection honestly require new observers; artifact kind and task operations are directly observable. Missing-field handling and activation elaborations are declared additions.

audit.summary: All 15 segments survive at their claimed destinations, including the sizing inputs, architectural-complexity point system, and mandatory splitting for both classes of limits. The then contains one sizing obligation, while splitting remains explicit imperative coder-facing guidance; additional guidance is declared, with no waivers or shared-node relocation.

segmentChecks.note: The exact max-based sizing requirement is in then, both splitting obligations remain imperative in prefer/avoid, and the full statement is retained in audit.
The then, evidence, and verifier_detail all require size to equal exactly max(WMBT size, Footprint size); requiring the field to be present follows from that equality.
Both then and prefer[0] explicitly derive the WMBT size bracket from covers_wmbts, with an exact restatement in verifier_detail.
The footprint remains an architectural-complexity point score, and prefer[0] directs the planner to the rule defining that point system.
Exceeding component/event limits still requires splitting: prefer[1] says to split, avoid[1] forbids leaving it unsplit, and evidence makes an unsplit excess a failure.
The hard-limit categories tables/jobs/integrations are retained, with 'always split' in prefer and mandatory-split language in why and verifier_detail.

risks: The numeric brackets, point values, and limit thresholds are not inline; the planner must have and follow the explicitly referenced planner.feature.size-max-rule and planner.feature.hard-limits rules.

unobservable: change: field-level detection of set/changed/missing size, covers_wmbts, or footprint data requires a new diff/field observer.
finding: size mismatches, unverifiable sizing inputs, and exceeded limits require a new computed-validator observer.

review.summary: All six substantive segments are preserved without weakening either the sizing equality or mandatory splitting. The coder-facing procedure is clear when its referenced sizing and limit rules are available, and the auditor's PASS is justified; only the declared change/finding activation facts lack current deterministic observers.
